title: Group Master Account Billing, Actualization and File Closure (Group Room Blocks)
content:
### Billing room nights to the master account

Room nights are billed to a Group Room Blocks master account only for block types that allow master-account billing and only for the rooms the organiser designated on the contract; other attendees pay their own folios. The room nights billed this way, which are the total of the room nights on the block's master-account room-charge entries over the whole life of the block, never exceed the pickup.

### Actualization

The block is actualized by the system after its departure date, when the deposits held are applied to the master account.

### Payment and settlement

Organiser payments reduce the master account. Where the block type allows direct billing, the master account is invoiced after the event and is due within the block type's payment term of calendar days; otherwise it is settled by card at departure.

### Posting and closure

A master account entry is posted only on a block whose status is definite, actualized or cancelled. The file is closed only when the master balance is zero: an actualized block's file is closed once its master account is settled to zero, and a cancelled block's file is closed once any cancellation damages are settled. A credit balance on the master account is refunded to the organiser's payment card and never carried to another block.

### Posting by status

| Block status | Master account entry may be posted |
|---|---|
| tentative | No |
| definite | Yes |
| actualized | Yes |
| cancelled | Yes |
| closed | No |

### Settlement route by block type setting

| Direct billing allowed | Master account settled |
|---|---|
| Yes | by invoice after the event, due within the payment term |
| No | by card at departure |

### Closure check (hypothetical balances)

| Master balance | File may be closed |
|---|---|
| 0.00 USD | Yes |
| 125.00 USD owed | No |
